blocks.x: This is all what is this from 1983. This is Sugar Bowl Parade. These are things that I've written and that I get royalties from.
That's yeah. Two beat music. It's now it's now MCA.

I don't know what the hell it is. I don't even remember. They put my name on it. This one's $83. I get a statement from this is from Pops. I don't know what the hell this is. I don't remember this. Oh, this is when they tore Tulane Stadium down.
